transcript.text: Thank you, Nadia. I also need to flag an issue on the export-control side. After reviewing NovaBio's technical specifications this week, I classified the licensed encryption module as subject to U.S. export controls. This means the agreement must prohibit sublicensing to embargoed jurisdictions and require export screening before each transfer. The current draft has no export-control language whatsoever, and I have not yet marked up the draft to address this. This is a compliance issue that needs to be resolved before we can approve the package.
